top_signals.title: Top House Oversight Democrat warns Trump family to 'lawyer up'
top_signals.summary: With Democrats set to take control of the House in January, Rep. Robert Garcia is promising sweeping probes into Trump, his family and his administration.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
